scopeNote: These eleven cities had documented registry/map leads. Only two currently pass live parcel geometry integration. Registry existence does not imply anonymous, complete polygon access.

cities.name: Semapur
technicalBlockers: Exact Semapur revenue mauza containing the WUP coordinate is unresolved; the nearest tested Barari(254) CS sheet is about 8.9 km away.
The public viewer returns WMS raster imagery and single-plot IDs/bboxes only; no complete bounded parcel polygon response was found in the tested public-client routes.

cities.name: Darauli
technicalBlockers: Exact revenue mauza for the WUP coordinate is unresolved; it lies outside all four exposed Darauli(157) CS sheet extents.
The public viewer has no verified bounded viewport polygon response; WMS is raster and OP=4/PNIU provide bbox envelopes only.

cities.name: Raghunathpur
technicalBlockers: Exact revenue mauza for the WUP coordinate is unresolved; it lies outside all three exposed Raghunathpur(384) CS sheet extents.
The public viewer has no verified bounded viewport polygon response; WMS is raster and OP=4/PNIU provide bbox envelopes only.

cities.name: Nandail
technicalBlockers: Nandail has local cadastral-map records. The current and alternate public survey selectors do not expose its target sheet; nearby Achargaon catalog entries are non-georeferenced preview images, not parcel vectors.

cities.name: Saghatta
technicalBlockers: Saghatta has local cadastral-map records. The public survey selectors do not expose its target sheet; nearby Kamaler Para catalog entries are non-georeferenced preview images, not parcel vectors.

cities.name: Venjaramoodu
limitations: Only published Manikkal village is configured.
Empty untyped HTTP 200 bodies remain unavailable errors. The enclosing default grid avoids empty subcell responses at the entry point.

cities.name: Dongjiao
technicalBlockers: The Dongjiao target resolves to Dongqiao Town in Putian/Xiuyu. Official cadastral-map access uses certificate QR lookup; no anonymous viewport and exact-ID polygon service was verified.

cities.name: Dajindian
technicalBlockers: Dajindian registry notices and a local map-query workflow are documented. The public map offers basemaps; parcel lookup needs a known identifier, and vector downloads require real-name access and a contract or allocation record.

cities.name: Aleppo
technicalBlockers: Aleppo cadastral office issues registry statements and survey plans. The officially linked electronic-service portal did not connect from this network, and no anonymous Aleppo parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

cities.name: Mbale City
technicalBlockers: Mbale has an NLIS registry office. The public cadastral-division viewer configures administrative zones, districts, offices and basemaps, with no parcel layer. Its advertised GeoServer routes returned 404.
